sentences.en: They are dancing, intoxicated with the beauty of cherry blossoms.
sentences.zh: 他们正在跳舞，沉醉于樱花之美。

sentences.en: I enjoy reading, cuddling by the fireplace and slow dancing.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢坐在壁炉旁依偎着阅读和跳慢舞。

sentences.en: When the cat is not there, the mice are dancing.
sentences.zh: 猫不在的时候，老鼠们就开始狂欢（暗指没有天敌时的放肆行为）
